title: Computing the Integral R2 Indicator by Perspective Mapping and Box Decomposition
summary: The continuous integral R2 indicator is a Pareto-compliant refinement of the classical finite-weight-vector R2 indicator, used in performance assessment, bounded archiving for a-posteriori multi-objective optimization, and skyline selection in databases. This work introduces a bidirectional perspective mapping between continuous integral R2 computation and integration over unions of anchored axis-aligned boxes.
